info.title: Question-directed artist research
info.description: Preview contract. Apply the Web-owned research schema before enabling the matching API implementation. Web Ask About reserves a bounded planning slot before its model call: at most 10 new question plans per artist and 200 globally over rolling 24 hours, recorded without question or conversation text. This is separate from the API research ledgers; polling existing jobs does not plan again. Rejected reservations perform no model call. Planning uses no automatic model retries.

post.description: Enqueue or reuse bounded public-evidence research. Checks saved originals first. Explicit URL and date constraints can select stored originals even without matching words in their body. No scraping in enqueue. Never approves Lore or attaches a profile. Newest-available retrieval first checks stored dated public evidence, including own social captions and responses already published in Latest. Stored Spotify/Deezer release catalogs and InProcess moments share durable snapshots with the public Latest endpoint. Provider refreshes run only in queued latest_refresh work; question/status/original reads never refresh these providers. The API worker explores the saved public snapshot with paginated browsing, model-chosen searches and exact source-window reads before selecting unchanged evidence. It returns durable job status and references, not a listener-facing answer. Music Nerd Web's private server-to-server HTTP adapter can reopen current originals and draft/check a cited answer; that adapter is application code, not a published client SDK. If stored evidence is insufficient, the model chooses a next lookup from server-validated web, page or connected social options based on the missing information. There is no fixed social-platform priority. Explicit URL/platform restrictions, account identity and existing provider budgets still constrain execution; the chosen plan is persisted and revalidated before subsequent job slices. Web pages retain explicit publication metadata when unambiguous; unknown dates remain unknown, never replaced by fetch time. Every new job reserves one slot in the rolling global saved-question admission cap (100 per 24 hours), with no per-artist saved-chat cap. This is an operational request limit, not a dollar spending guarantee. Direct or saved-source answers consume no outside-research slot. Only when insufficient saved evidence leads to a validated external lookup does the server reserve outside allowance (5 per artist and 100 globally per rolling 24 hours). That reservation is atomic, lease-fenced, and idempotent for the same job; all existing per-job provider/model/lifetime limits still apply. Exhausted outside allowance ends the job unresolved without starting a provider, with outsideResearchReason=quota plus quotaScope, retryAfterSeconds and resetAt. Exhausted global saved admission returns saved_evidence_quota (429), quotaScope=saved_global, and the same reset fields; Retry-After matches retryAfterSeconds. Reset timing comes from the actual rolling-window boundary and is an estimate assuming no newer reservations consume capacity. Old jobs retain their original quota accounting until their rolling window expires. Single-active-job research_busy remains distinct. Completed matching jobs can be reused independently of these admission limits, subject to current eligibility and cache lifetime. Cache identity preserves topic and all source/date/evidence constraints; reuse is not restricted to an arbitrary last-ten-jobs window. Saved research reads all eligible originals within the existing corpus guard, independently of the Latest UI card limits. Published answers retain publication eligibility and private answers remain excluded. Partial saved support is revalidated and combined with newly collected originals before final assessment. Saved selection returns at most 12,000 original characters; combined outside assessment can return at most six windows totaling 24,000 characters. Exploration uses a current public-research model through AI Gateway, with per-step reservation and usage tracking; external provider budgets are unchanged. Service callers may opt into preferDirectEvidence: true to offer bounded saved candidates before model-driven evidence exploration. This option is not part of the persisted neutral request. Selection candidates means evidence is ready for a checked answer attempt, not that it answers the question. At most six exact windows and 12,000 characters are selected. Latest reporting overviews select the six newest distinct canonical posts first, preferring written evidence over a duplicate transcript, then interleave providers only within that cohort. For overview follow-ups with excluded source URLs and no target URL, known In Process posts from the same connected account and stable collection URL contribute their newest eligible representative before the six-candidate limit. Other social posts remain separate activities. Collection names and question keywords do not determine grouping. This diversifies candidate evidence without treating an entire collection as excluded or answered; focused requests and overviews without exclusions keep individual-post selection. Explicit source, platform, evidence-kind, date and URL exclusions still apply. Semantic project exclusions remain an answer-layer obligation. An empty selection enters ordinary research. Candidate jobs reserve the same quota once and preserve normal claim and expiry checks. Legacy callers never reuse a candidate-only job. A client using candidate selection is responsible for registering its answer attempt and rereading the current originals before drafting. In Web Ask About, after source rereads and revision checks, a schema-valid zero-sentence writer result is treated as a candidate miss and continues this same job. The independent factual checker is not called when there are no factual sentences, so this path is not an independently verified finding about evidence sufficiency or absence. A failed source read, stale revision, quote/fact check on a nonempty draft, or model/transport operation withholds the answer and must not automatically trigger outside collection; retain the job for a bounded retry. Fact-bearing limitations are claims too: they must be scoped to checked evidence, cite supporting originals and pass the same source/claim checks; process-only status text must not imply absence beyond what was checked. Free-form unanswered prose is not a verified answer. Public request constraints belong in the neutral topic and applicable structured fields; do not include raw conversation or private artist memory. Planner/writer changes apply to newly processed work. Web does not version-bust its request binding for this rollout, so existing verified answers remain eligible for their normal 24-hour reuse window.

get.description: Reopen an exact source/revision/window. A URL-encoded discovery:UUID, vault:UUID public_answer:UUID or social:UUID:caption|transcript sourceId is accepted; a bare evidence UUID remains supported. Saved Lore/social reads use the current eligible public revision and return 409 on change. Retained discovery versions remain readable while current curation and access permit them. Published responses already visible in Latest are eligible with exact response text; edited responses invalidate old revisions and unpublished/deleted responses become unavailable. Uploaded/private material, private interview sessions and correction history are excluded. Current claimant/admin may inspect unresolved discoveries for review.

post.summary: Continue after a saved-candidate answer attempt
post.description: Service-only, idempotent transition of a candidate job into ordinary bounded research after the caller has reread current originals and identified an insufficient candidate result. In Web Ask About, this transition follows a schema-valid zero-sentence writer result; the adapter has reopened and revision-checked the originals, but the independent factual checker does not run because there are no factual sentences. This path is not an independently verified finding about sufficiency or absence. Failed source reads, stale revisions, quote/fact checks on a nonempty draft, and model/transport errors withhold the answer and remain bounded retryable failures; they do not automatically start outside collection. Send no body or an empty JSON object; client routing, counters, permissions and source overrides are rejected. The same job ID, original neutral request, activity, quota lane, created time and model/provider counters are preserved. A candidate job transitions atomically once under the artist/job lock, subject to current claim, original lifetime and the one-active-question limit. Repeated calls return the current job status. Clients must fence an in-flight candidate answer lease before continuing, retain answer registration, and retry the checked answer against the new current references. This operation does not extend budgets, expiry or reset answer retry limits. It never decides that candidate evidence is sufficient. New-budget continuation preserves the single global saved admission and does not charge outside allowance; outside allowance is reserved only if a later validated lookup requires external collection.

ResearchService.name: X-MusicNerd-Research-Key
ResearchService.description: Server-only MUSICNERD_RESEARCH_API_KEY. Public evidence research only; never grants review or interview-history access.

topic.description: Neutral public work/topic terms, not private visitor chat.

freshness.description: For relevance retrieval, recent defaults to the past seven days unless fromDate is supplied. For latest retrieval, newest available evidence may be older; answers must preserve its actual date and coverage limitations.

platform.description: Restrict evidence to this platform, including when targetUrl is supplied. InProcess and catalog providers use stored Latest snapshots. If these cannot answer, research ends unresolved with provider_latest_refresh_required; no unrelated social provider is selected. Conflicting platform and target URL ends unresolved with source_platform_mismatch.

retrieval.description: Use latest for a newest-available activity overview or newest post on a requested platform. Selects dated originals in descending order without requiring topic keyword overlap or imposing a seven-day cutoff. Explicit fromDate/toDate bounds still apply. Use relevance for a specific topic or fact; latest is not proof of current exhaustive coverage. For latest release_date requests, prefer eligible catalog originals with activityDateKind=release after applying explicit source and date constraints. If none exist, other eligible originals may be read as candidates; their publication dates never establish release dates.

excludeSourceUrls.description: Exact public citation URLs already discussed; excluded before evidence selection and included in request identity.

answerScope.description: Use overview for a broad account of recent activity, focused for a specific post, release or detail. The agent can browse all eligible saved public sources by page or provider, search with its own terms, and read exact original windows. Broad browsing includes multiple available providers instead of selecting only the newest posts from one busy account. Source, date, URL, speech and exclusion constraints remain authoritative. Exploration is bounded by five model steps, twelve tool calls, 24,000 original-text characters, and the job slice deadline. Saved exploration returns at most six read windows and 12,000 characters; an overview selects up to three distinct useful activities. A limit or invalid selection is an operational failure, not evidence that information is absent. Outside collection keeps its existing budgets and can run only from a validated server plan. Saved exploration does not refresh providers. This is not a comprehensive freshness guarantee.

preferDirectEvidence.description: Service credential only. Offer bounded candidates for a checked answer attempt before normal research. Optional and false by default; not persisted in the neutral request or its identity.

quotaScope.description: Shared operational budget that blocked this work, never a personal visitor limit.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds until resetAt, rounded up. A current status read recomputes this duration; new traffic can consume later capacity.

resetAt.description: Actual rolling-window boundary calculated when the quota was checked.

outsideResearchReason.description: Outside collection was not admitted. Saved sources may still provide a bounded answer. New quota-blocked jobs include a shared quota scope and reset time; retry from a new question after reset, without restarting this terminal job. Older saved-only jobs can omit reset metadata.

selection.description: Optional for legacy jobs. candidates is an unassessed evidence selection, not an answer or a sufficiency finding. In Web Ask About, a schema-valid zero-sentence writer result after source rereads/revision checks is treated as an insufficient candidate result and continues this same job; no independent factual-checker result exists for this empty draft. Failed reads, stale revisions, quote/fact checks on a nonempty draft, and model/transport errors withhold the answer and do not automatically trigger outside collection. research means the normal bounded research path.

sourceId.description: Stable current source reference, including latest:<spotify|deezer|inprocess>:<64hex> provider snapshot originals. Removing/changing the connected account or successfully refreshing away a hidden/removed item makes its old reference unavailable; changed originals have a different revision.

activityDate.description: Optional provider activity date. Preserves YYYY, YYYY-MM or full date/time precision. Never substitutes for source publication time.

activityDateKind.description: Meaning of activityDate. Exact catalog release-date claims require original catalog text, not publishedAt.
